words.headline: Monday Thermostat Revolt: Single-Apartment No-Heat Calls Double
words.blurb: No-heat and hot water complaints hit 2,355 on a Monday that dipped to 36°, well above the usual 1,524. Reports of one cold apartment jumped to 633, more than twice the typical 312.
words.card_line: Sweaters on, radiators still thinking it over

boroughs.Bronx: Home repairs led with 955, and 798 no-heat calls weren't far behind.
boroughs.Brooklyn: Parking wars ruled at 1,427, with 1,011 home repair calls in the mix.
boroughs.Manhattan: Home repairs topped at 697 while 525 no-heat calls kept the radiators busy.
boroughs.Queens: Parking wars ran away with it at 906, more than home repairs and no heat combined.
boroughs.Staten Island: A quiet 91 parking wars calls led, trailed by 69 home repairs.

rare_finds.quip: Status: complaint received. Socks weighed. Socks reweighed. Inspector dispatched, ETA two spin cycles and a fiscal quarter.

rare_finds.name: Travel agency: advertising false or misleading
rare_finds.quip: The city keeps an official box for vacations that didn't match the brochure. The box itself, naturally, is booked solid until spring.
